facts.fact: The DHIS2 project's country profile says DHIS2 has been Guinea-Bissau's national health management information system since 2013, covering routine data on a range of health programmes, and describes the existing DHIS2 systems as locally owned, with the Ministry of Health leading the work on them with Saudigitus (HISP Mozambique).

The DHIS2 Climate App, the Chap Modeling Platform and the DHIS2 Modeling App have been installed on a DHIS2 testing instance, not the national production system, to explore combining climate data with HMIS data at facility catchment level; the page is stamped as updated July 2026 and gives no installation date.
